newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Monday set a one-week repo tender to add market liquidity of a fixed volume of 6.0 billion crowns.
The minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS added 3.5 billion crowns to the local money market through a three-day repo tender on Friday with an average yield rising to 18.78 percent, from 18.60 percent on Thursday.
The NBS monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 13 lacked some 0.42 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserve requirements on July 15.
